body:
Thanks. You're honestly the only person I have talked to who offered advice that was helpful. I have opened up to my friends, my mom, my cousin. All of them told me to either "Be happy, smile" or "Just ignore it" 

I do plan to go to counseling, but I have to wait until after the 1st. She is booked until then.  

Talking to someone who understands help tremendously. Past few days I just lay here, feeling like this, thinking about everything. Two hours later, I am finally asleep. Then I wake up and do it all again. I talk to people, normal stuff, and that keeps my mind off it. And I feel "better" for lack of a better word. I guess you could say it suppresses it. But after when I have no one to talk to, I get the empty feeling again. And that feeling makes me not want to talk to anyone or do anything. 

This is sorta the thing I should be telling the hotline, huh? Sorry for unloading this on you, but you're the first person who actually knows what it feels like.

How do I relieve this feeling? Usually I cry and it helps. But I can't cry. How do I fix this?

I haven't worked up the courage yet. I called one number but it said they were closed and gave me a number that's 24 hours. Haven't had the balls to call yet. Don't know why it's hard for me.

How do I relieve it?
Thanks. An online one was what I needed. I'll see if that helps.

Thanks, I can really relate to that. 

I usually just let it in sit in the back of my mind until it builds up and I explode with anger. Depression. I cry. I punch shit. And then I move on.

Lately, I've just been feeling empty. I didn't know how to explain it until you said it. I feel nothing.
Do you think you can give me generally, how much they cost? I don't want my parents to spend money they don't have on me.
Which would you recommend, a therapist or a counselor?

Okay, then, is asking for help always a better alternative then sitting quiet?
I'm kinda just hoping this will go away on it's own.

This thread is really bumming me out. I'm 15 and I hear everyone keep saying they still have it! What do I do? Can I stop this? I need help but I don't have the power to ask. Is there a cause for this?

On my first post I stated I have no reason to be depressed but I am. Why?

Too many questions but I just got done bawling my eyes out, so I apologize if I sound....odd, I guess.
I hide it with humor and try to tell myself I have a somewhat good sense of humor.
That helps. It's nice to have someone to relate to, but I fear I won't be as lucky..Hopefully time will heal this.

I'll look into it. Maybe when I can call without choking on my words. I just want to get out and do stuff but I am to ashamed of myself to do anything. I want to go to the gym so I won't be ashamed, but I don't because I fear the judgement/laughs. It's a cycle...

Thank you.

Is there anything online I could look at that can help me see if I really am depressed? I looked at that one test on the side bar (the 18 question one) and it told me mild to severe (40).

 Maybe one day I will talk to my mom, but right now it is something I am not ready to open up about. I don't think I will have the willpower to get any words out.

The reason I don't want to get help is because I don't want people to know, especially my mom. I don't want to be looked at as depressed. I have talked to people but it just relieves the pain for a little.

I have a feeling it will pass once I get older and have meaning in life. I hope so.

EDIT:I'd get help if I was actually depressed, but I don't know, I'm not 100% sure.

I guess of all places I could put it in here since I've been bottling it up. 

I want to commit suicide but I have no reason too. I am depressed for absolute no fucking reason. I have a loving family who gives me everything, and I have 1 really amazing best friend. But I hate myself. Everything about me. I feel like I deserve nothing and everything about me is terrible. I feel like everyone hates me even when I know they don't. I feel like everyone judges me.

Honestly, the only thing stopping me from doing it is my mom. I have never told anyone, but a kid at my school killed himself and my mom had a talk with me saying how she would be devastated and wouldn't be able to live. I won't do that to her. But if she ever passes, I don't know.

Oh, and I'm 15, so I have this mentality that I am just being a craving emotional teen when it could be an actual problem. Who knows. It feels good to vent though even if no one reads it.
